anchors.name: CASCADE-DYN-37
anchors.source_context_30_lines:
121: The correct BBN computation would:
  122: 1. Identify which saddle tau occupies during BBN
  123: 2. Compute the spectral action at that saddle (not the fold)
  124: 3. Compare the expansion rate at the saddle to standard GR
  125: 4. Assess whether the saddle-scale wall structure modifies H(T_BBN) in the lithium-resolving window [-0.15, -0.03]
  126: 
  127: This requires:
  128: - Mapping the saddle structure of S_f(tau) with the physical cutoff (CUTOFF-SA-37)
  129: - Computing the tau(t) trajectory through the cascade (CASCADE-DYN-37)
  130: - Evaluating a_0, a_2 at the saddle tau, not the fold tau
  131: 
  132: ### Level 4 Candidacy
  133: 
  134: If the cascade dynamics determines:
  135: 1. Which saddle tau occupies during BBN (from the tau(t) trajectory)
  136: 2. The spectral action coefficients at that saddle (from the cutoff computation)
  137: 3. The resulting delta_H/H falls in [-0.15, -0.03]
